name: Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro 'Carpe Diem' 2019
story_html: First debuted in 2009, the Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro 'Carpe Diem' sneaker returns in June 2019 to honor the Los Angeles Lakers. Notes of team-inspired colors are seen throughout the synthetic, thermo-molded upper, Swooshes and quilted textile collar. A tongue emblem, snakeskin-textured detailing and a signature on the external heel nod to the legendary player. Lunar foam and Zoom Air cushioning tech combine to energize the rubber outsole.
